validity_findings.finding: Decompressed determinism under varying brotli quality is tautological in this harness: mock server emits deterministic uncompressed bodies, CDN proxy applies brotli.compress (lossless) with quality 4-8, decompress is guaranteed identical by brotli spec. H1 cannot fail unless brotli library is buggy; experiment therefore validates library correctness and proxy wiring rather than discovering a contingent CDN effect. Producer discloses this construction (spec measurement_valid #4, prereg 5.1) and bounds ceiling to localhost proxy. Not measurement-invalid, but information gain is limited to confirming wiring.

validity_findings.finding: Synthetic padded content is highly compressible and underestimates both size scaling and quality diversity. Nominal 1KB/10KB/100KB uncompressed sizes compress to ~69-72 bytes (JSON/XML) and ~172-197 bytes (HTML) with brotli; compressed size barely increases 1KB->100KB (report decompression latency scales 0.02ms->0.25ms but size does not). Compressed hash variation shows only 2 unique (JSON/XML) or 3 (HTML) despite 5 quality levels observed, confirming qualities 5-8 produce identical bytes for this content. Producer notes 3-way error collapse ceiling and padding artifact (prereg 8 validity_threats #4, report Validity Threats #4). Representation loss limits generalizability to natural content; diversity scaling question remains open as inherited unknown.

validity_findings.finding: Proxy header forwarding duplicates Server and Content-Type headers (e.g., 'Server: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.12.14, BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.12.14' and 'Content-Type: application/json, application/json' in raw_observations.json). Caused by CDNQualityProxy forwarding original headers then unconditionally adding Content-Type (run_experiment.py:375-378). Does not affect decompression or discrimination (Content-Encoding is correctly isolated) and C_COMPRESSION_ACTIVE still passes with br on all observations, but indicates proxy implementation slop.

Scope is exclusively localhost mock server + CDN proxy with uniform random quality 4-8, N=20 per state per type per size (720 logical requests per endpoint per baseline, 2880 total via duplicated baselines_to_run), seed 44 ordering + 7919 quality RNG, no Accept-Encoding negotiation, no chunked transfer-encoding, no caching, no real CDN edge. Producer correctly discloses all boundaries in spec measurement_valid, prereg 8-9, report Claim Ceiling and Validity Threats. No leakage of outcome into measurement because decompressed hash excludes compressed representation by construction (fingerprint_decompressed uses decompress_body).

Baselines_to_run duplicates the same proxy measurement under two labels DECOMPRESSED-VARYING-BROTLI and COMPRESSED-VARYING-BROTLI (both go through identical CDN proxy, same 80 requests per type x size per endpoint). Metrics are duplicated (36 metric entries are 18 logical conditions x2). Wasteful but not invalid; does not inflate decision rule because rule evaluates only /userinfo DECOMPRESSED entries. No double-counting of pass criteria.

claim_ceiling: Decompression-normalization (SHA256 on decompressed body + status) preserves body-only discrimination at 0.5 under uniform random brotli quality variation {4,5,6,7,8} on localhost. Ceiling bounded to: localhost mock OAuth2 server with CDN quality proxy (mock uncompressed -> proxy brotli recompress per-request random quality, independent RNG seed 7919), synthetic padded JSON/HTML/XML at nominal 1KB/10KB/100KB (effective compressed ~70 bytes JSON/XML, ~178 bytes HTML, repetitive padding), 4 auth states with 3-way error collapse (structural ceiling 0.5), no Accept-Encoding negotiation, no chunked encoding, no caching, N=20 per state per type per size, seed 44. Does NOT establish real-CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) survival, natural content, binary types, or production latency/CPU.
